component.name: WorkerTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "drain" m.port = CreateObject("roMessagePort") m.top.observeField("request", m.port) m.global.observeField("ticket", m.port) end sub
sub drain() seen = [] ' Long enough to catch a late duplicate, so the test fails on an extra event rather than ' racing past it. for attempt = 0 to 30 msg = wait(100, m.port) if type(msg) = "roSGNodeEvent" data = msg.getData() if data <> "" then seen.push(msg.getField() + "=" + data) end if end for print "TASK SAW: "; seen.join(",") m.top.report = seen.count().toStr() + " events" end sub
